title: re4

derivation.chokepoints: derived: parallel walls >=1000 mm tall, gap <= 1500 mm, floor between
derivation.cover: derived: SOLID wall >= 500 mm long, height span 600..1400 mm
derivation.floor.polygons: measured mask merged to rectangles (row runs, equal runs merged downwards)

gaps: spawn positions: the nav table carries only a count (spawns.count/reachable); the .esl set lists would settle it
named places are grid blocks plus bonuses; the game's own room names are not in the tables
walls are SAT segments of every storey merged; per-storey floors are not separated
